attchmntText: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 29622.15 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 21563.09 lakhs in the previous year. Profit after tax was 146.19 lakhs for the quarter, versus 1.41 lakhs previously. For the half year, revenue was 5113.58 lakhs and profit after tax was 106.52 lakhs. The statutory auditors, M/s. Venugopal & Chenoy, issued an unmodified conclusion on these results. The board also noted the correction of the PIN Code in the registered office address and the related party transactions undertaken during the quarter. The meeting was held on 14th November 2026.
